subtitle: Engeza uye phezulu
short_description: Akha kabusha ipiramidi yezinombolo kusukela ezimpawu ezimbalwa ezisabalele.
description:
Thola amadijithi amane, angu-1 kuya ku-9, ngaphansi kwepiramidi. Lilinye ngalinye lamatshe ayisithupha aphezulu linganisa isamba samatshe amabili aqondile phansi kwalo, futhi izimpawu ezimbalwa ezilungisiwe zikuqondisa.

Khetha itshe elingaphansi bese ufaka idijithi; amatshe aphezulu abonisa amasamba njengoba uqhubeka.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
